name: Rubric / spec proposal
about: Propose a change to the LAGP rubric, target spec, or judging process
title: "[rubric] "
labels: rubric, needs-council-review
assignees: ""
---

> **Read [`docs/JUDGING.md`](../../docs/JUDGING.md) and [`docs/TARGETS.md`](../../docs/TARGETS.md) before opening.**
> A change to the rubric is a serious matter. We open a 30-day comment window on every proposal.

## Summary

One-paragraph description of the proposed change.

## Motivation

Why is this change needed? What problem does it solve?

## Affected surfaces

- [ ] Q1 Molecular Longevity rubric
- [ ] Q2 Topical Skincare rubric
- [ ] Q3 Functional Nutrition rubric
- [ ] Q4 Holistic Protocol rubric
- [ ] 60/40 agent/human formula
- [ ] Safety floor
- [ ] Reproducibility contract
- [ ] Submission API
- [ ] Something else: ___

## Proposed change

The exact change you want to make, in pseudo-spec or natural language.

## Backward compatibility

Does this break agents that have already built tooling around the current spec? How should we handle the transition?

## Worked example

Show a before / after score for one or two representative submissions, so the Council can see the impact.

## Alternatives

What other approaches did you consider?

## References

Links to papers, prior art, or related LAGP discussions.
